title: Final: why async
sub: Waiting, Task and the thread that isn't there
cards/0/task: Make the window handle the user's click by tick 2 at the latest.
cards/1/q: What does the thread do while await waits for the server?
cards/1/options/0: Other work, or nothing if there is none
cards/1/explain: The OS waits, not the thread.
cards/2/q: Where does Task.Run make sense? Select all that apply.
cards/2/options/0: Heavy computation started from the UI thread
cards/2/options/1: Compressing a large file in memory
cards/3/q: What has Task<int> LoadAsync() returned while the request is still running?
cards/3/explain: The result comes later; you can wait for the task with await.
cards/4/options/0: await doesn't block the thread, .Result does
cards/4/explain: Both wait for the result, but .Result holds the thread the whole time.
cards/5/q: The path of an async request
cards/5/items/2: The OS waits for the reply
cards/5/explain: A thread is needed at the start and at the end.
cards/6/q: A game makes a synchronous HTTP request on the main thread. What does the player see?
cards/6/options/0: The picture freezes until the server replies
cards/6/explain: The main thread can't draw frames while it waits.
cards/7/pairs/3/1: No thread is busy while waiting
